title: Milo’s Backyard Adventure
moral: Being kind and careful makes adventures safe and happy.

scenes.summary: Milo prepares for an adventure in his backyard.
scenes.text: Milo wore his yellow boots and packed his backpack, ready to explore his backyard like a wild land.
scenes.image_prompt: little boy with yellow boots and backpack in backyard, soft pastel cartoon style

scenes.summary: Milo finds ants in his camp spot and must decide what to do.
scenes.text: Milo saw a line of ants in his camp spot and realized he should not step on them.
scenes.image_prompt: child looking at ants on grass thinking carefully, cute children book illustration

scenes.summary: Milo finds a way to safely build his camp.
scenes.text: He used sticks and a bowl to make a safe path for the ants and moved his camp to another spot.
scenes.image_prompt: child placing sticks and bowl as bridge for ants, bright friendly cartoon

scenes.summary: Milo enjoys his careful camping experience.
scenes.text: Milo sat at his camp, ate a cracker, and felt proud of being careful and kind.
scenes.image_prompt: child sitting on blanket camping peacefully in backyard, warm cartoon style

scenes.summary: Milo cleans up and ends his adventure happily.
scenes.text: Milo packed up neatly, left everything safe, and went home feeling proud of his adventure.
scenes.image_prompt: child cleaning backyard and going home with parent, cozy sunset cartoon

story: Milo wore his yellow boots and packed his backpack for a backyard adventure. He chose a spot and called it Camp Milo. When he saw ants walking through, he decided not to step on them. Instead, he used sticks and a bowl to help them pass safely and moved his camp. Milo enjoyed his time, eating a cracker and listening to the breeze. Later, he cleaned up everything carefully and went home feeling proud and happy.
